**Severity:** error · **Area:** Static calls (i18n) (`RV4xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Tag param must be (children) => <jsx>
```

```text
Tag param JSX must be static native markup around {children}
```

```text
Message tags ({tag} in "{key}") are not supported in t.in(): it returns a string, and tags need JSX content. Use t() in JSX (children, a prop, a variable), or a message without tags
```

```text
Message tags ({tag} in "{key}") are not supported in {position}: attribute values are strings, and tags need JSX content. Use a message without tags here, or render this one as JSX (children, a prop, a variable)
```

```text
Message tag {tag} in "{key}" cannot be lowered here
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Render tagged messages only as JSX children with tag params of the form (c) => `<b>{c}</b>` (static native markup); use a tagless message in attributes and `t.in()`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("terms", { link: (c) => <Link>{c}</Link> });
```

```tsx prefer
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("terms", { link: (c) => <a href="/terms">{c}</a> });
```

## When it is reported

'cannot be lowered here' variant lacks a hint. `classify()` prefix 'Tags inside plural/select' has no emitter (dead pattern). Build only.
